issue: Maya pays for the SIM card twice.
why: At the end of Scene 4, Maya pays for the 300 rupee SIM card ("I give the money"). At the end of Scene 5, she pays for it again ("I give him three hundred rupees"). This is a direct continuity error in the same transaction.

issue: Double payment for the SIM card.
why: Maya pays for the SIM card at the end of Scene 4 ('ഞാൻ പണം കൊടുക്കുന്നു.' / 'I give the money.') but then pays the 300 rupees again at the end of Scene 5 ('ഞാൻ അയാൾക്ക് മുന്നൂറ് രൂപ കൊടുക്കുന്നു.' / 'I give him three hundred rupees.'). She should only hand over the money once.

issue: Overuse of 'I am very happy' to conclude scenes.
why: Scenes 1, 2, 8, and 9 all feature Maya stating some variation of 'I am very happy' or 'I have great happiness' at or near the very end. While repetition is useful for beginners, relying on this exact emotional note to close almost half the scenes makes her inner monologue feel a bit robotic.

issue: Monotonous emotional conclusions across multiple scenes.
why: Scenes 1, 2, 8, and 9 all use nearly the exact same phrase ('I am very happy' / എനിക്ക് വളരെ സന്തോഷമുണ്ട്) as a concluding emotional beat, which makes the narrative arc feel repetitive.

issue: Excessive refrain about January and good weather.
why: Scenes 1, 2, 6, 8, and 9 all explicitly state that it is January and that the weather/morning is pleasant. While repeating vocabulary is good, stating this exact same trivia fact in five out of nine scenes is unnaturally repetitive for a single sitting.

issue: Double payment for the SIM card.
why: In Scene 4, Maya learns the SIM is 300 rupees and pays ('ഞാൻ പണം കൊടുക്കുന്നു'). In Scene 5, after testing the number, she pays 300 rupees again ('ഞാൻ അയാൾക്ക് മുന്നൂറ് രൂപ കൊടുക്കുന്നു'). This creates a narrative hiccup where it feels like she is paying twice.
